text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Having been taught the particulars behind the job by Makoto,
{0} joins her in patrolling the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕事内容を{0}に教えたマコトは、
二人で海辺の見回りを始める。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look!
That has to be it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
あった！
あれじゃねぇか？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
This is the pouch you lost, isn't it?
It's even got the cat-shaped seashell you mentioned.
text_block_list.orig_text:
嬢ちゃん、
落としたポーチって
これだろ？
言ってた通り、
猫型の貝殻も付いてるし。

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's it.
It really means a lot to me, so thanks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
これだよ。
ありがとうお姉ちゃん！
　大切なものだったの！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
No prob. Just don't drop it again, okay?
I gotta file a report, too, so drop by the station over there later for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう。
もう落とすんじゃねぇぞ？
一応報告はしなきゃだから、
あとであっちの詰め所に来てくれな？

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text:
Oh nooo!
A fight's broken out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃああっ、
けんかよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: A fight?! I'll be right there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ！？
　待ってろ、
すぐ行く！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: I dropped my shaved ice thanks to you bumping into me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
てめぇが当たってきたせいで
かき氷落としちまっただろうが！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
My ass. You're the one too busy staring at your lady
to watch where you're going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ？
　よそ見して歩いてる方が悪いんだろ！？
女連れて歩いてっからそうなるんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's enough!
I get where you're both coming from, so let's leave it at that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーはいはい！
言い分は分かったから落ち着けって！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
We're at the beach, fellas.
Don't ruin it for everyone else. Okay?
choice_data_list: I brought this up with the people at the store.
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかく海にまで来てんだぜ？
周りの人間まで嫌な気分にさせんなよ。
な？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thanks.
Here. He got you a replacement for the shaved ice that you dropped.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
サンキュー{0}。
ほら、
かき氷落とした分
交換してくれるってよ。

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
R-right...
Sorry. That was pretty pathetic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ああ……
すまない。
みっともないことをしてしまったな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
As for you, don't make weird excuses.
He's allowed to take a stroll with anyone he wants.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたも、
変な因縁付けんじゃねぇよ。
誰連れて歩こうと勝手だろ？

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, you're right...
I was just jealous...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうだよな……
うらやましくて、
つい……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Now then. This'll be all done and done after you shake hands.
Glad I didn't have to settle this with force!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし。
じゃあ握手して、
けんかは終わりだな。
力づくで片付けることにならなくてよかったぜ！

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text:
Apologies for interrupting,
but my daughter's gone missing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お取込み中のところすみません、
娘が、
娘が迷子なんです！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Mind telling me what she looks like?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう分かった！
娘さんの特徴を教えてくれるか──

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Glad we were able to find her.
All thanks to you shouting to catch her attention.
text_block_list.orig_text:
迷子が見つかってよかったな。
{0}が大声で呼びかけてくれたおかげだぜ♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Today sure is hectic, though.
Feels like things keep going down everywhere we go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしてもほんと忙しいな。
どこに行っても何か起きてやがるし。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You must be pooped, huh?
I'm impressed you're keeping up.
choice_data_list: I'm always happy to help you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}もきついだろ？
ほんとよく付いてきてくれてるよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
That side of you is what Yui... Scratch that.
I think it's pretty great, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユイはおまえのそういうところが……
いや。
あたしも、
いいと思うぜ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
What?! How do you manage to blurt out those kind of lines so effortlessly?!
I really dunno how to respond when you do...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ！？
　
おまえ、
ほんとそういうのサラッと言うよな！
反応に困るからやめろよな……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Feels safe to assume that things've settled down around here, though.
text_block_list.orig_text: でもさすがにこの辺はもう落ち着いたかな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
How about we take a little break?
Gotta rest up while we can.
text_block_list.orig_text:
少し休憩でもするか？
休めるときに休んどかないとな。

text_block_list.name: PAU 1
text_block_list.text: Oh! Now here's a pretty looking lady!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
こんなところにイ～イ女がいるじゃねぇか……！

text_block_list.name: PAU 2
text_block_list.text:
Right on the money.
How's it going, babe? You having fun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当だなぁ。
どうだいネエちゃん、
楽しんでるかぁ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
What?
I'm busy. Go hit on someone else, will you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ？
今忙しいんだ。
ナンパならよそでやってくれ。

text_block_list.name: PAU 1
text_block_list.text: Damn. I like a girl with a fiery attitude.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいねぇ。
そういう気の強い女は
嫌いじゃねぇぜ。

text_block_list.name: PAU 2
text_block_list.text:
What say we have ourselves
a little summer escapade together?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうだい、
俺たちと
ひと夏限りのアバンチュール
といかないか？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm good.
I make it a point not to get strung along by weirdo playboys.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わりぃな。
品のねぇ誘い文句にはついていかないことにしてるんだ。

text_block_list.name: PAU 1
text_block_list.text: Aww, come on!
text_block_list.orig_text: そう言わずによぉ！

text_block_list.name: PAU 2
text_block_list.text: Aww, come on!
text_block_list.orig_text: そう言わずになぁ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Tch. They're tenacious, I'll give them that.
Normally I'd just give them a smack on the jaw.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ、
しつこいなこいつら。
いつもなら拳の一発でもくれちまうところではあるんだが……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
But I'm in beachside officer mode right now.
Violence ain't the answer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一応今は、
海のお巡りさんなわけだしな。
暴力はまずいよな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Um.
I'm really sorry, but could you leave me alone? Please?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～っと。
本当に申し訳ないんだけど、
他を当たってくれ……
ませんかね。

text_block_list.name: PAU 1
text_block_list.text:
What gives?
You think you can just give kind dudes like us the cold shoulder?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああん？
俺たちがこれだけ誘ってるのに
ダメだってのかぁ！？

text_block_list.name: PAU 2
text_block_list.text: And who the hell are you, huh?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ？
　なんだぁテメェは！？

text_block_list.name: PAU 1
text_block_list.text: You tryna imply that you're her man or something?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさかおまえ、
この女の彼氏だとでもいうのかぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
M-my man?!
Nah, no way! He's Yui's— Okay, not yet, but! Um!
text_block_list.orig_text:
かかか彼氏ぃっ！？
違うっての！
　こいつにはユイが、
いやまだだけど、
ええと……！

text_block_list.name: PAU 2
text_block_list.text:
If you ain't her man, then you better scram!
Heh. Not like anyone'd date a loser like you, anyway.
text_block_list.orig_text:
違うんだったら下がってな！
まぁ、
こんなひょろい男と
付き合うわけねぇよなぁ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me?

text_block_list.name: PAU 1
text_block_list.text:
For sure, dude!
He ain't got what it takes to hang with a babe like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
違いねぇ！
こんなセクシーな姉ちゃんには釣り合わねぇよなぁ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
That does it!
Grit your teeth, punks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
テメェら……ッ！
歯ぁ食いしばれっ！！

text_block_list.name: PAU 2
text_block_list.text: Eeek?!

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Wha—?!
Why're you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ！？
おまえ、なんで……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Why're you covering for them?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで、
そいつらをかばうんだよ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yeah. You're right.
I almost forgot my own job.
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！
　そうか、
そうだったよな……
自分の仕事、
忘れるところだったぜ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
For my sake?
Ahh. Yeah, I shouldn't forget my position.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしの……？
そっか、
忘れちゃいけねぇよな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I let my temper get the most of me there.
Thanks for stopping me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
頭に血がのぼっちまった。
ありがとよ、
止めてくれて。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Hey, you two.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
おまえら。

text_block_list.name: PAU 1
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な……
なんだよ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
We're here to help anyone in need.
Don't get in our way, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしらは困った人を助けるためにここにいるんだ。
その邪魔だけはしないでくれ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You're free to enjoy your time at the beach any way you like.
I won't stop you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナンパしようが何しようが、
海を楽しむのは自由だ。
好きにすりゃあいい。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
But if you so much as try and ruin it for anyone else, 
then let's just say that you're in for a big shock.
After all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもな。
もしおまえらが他に楽しんでいる誰かの邪魔をするのなら、
今度こそ容赦はしねぇ。
なにしろあたしは……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: These are the beachside officers you're dealing with. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしらは、
海のお巡りさんだからな♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Got it?
text_block_list.orig_text: 分かったか？

text_block_list.name: PAU 1
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ああ……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Great.
Then let's get going, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし。
じゃあ行こうぜ{0}。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh. That took up way too much time.
Hopefully nothing else happened while we were preoccupied.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ、
余計な時間を食っちまった。
また問題が増えてねぇといいけどな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah.
I should thank you again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
さっきは、
ありがとな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You wanna know what for?
You stopped me when I was about ready to cave their skulls in, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何が、
って、
あいつらぶっ飛ばしそうになったところを、
止めてくれただろ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: I honestly don't care what people say about me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に
あたしはどう言われようといいんだけどよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: But the same can't be said when people talk smack about you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}のことをバカにされると、
どうにもな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, me!
You're making this way too awkward.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってあたしのバカ！
　
これじゃまるで……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
D-don't get the wrong idea!
I just don't want people disrespecting my coworkers!
text_block_list.orig_text:
か、
勘違いすんなよ！
仕事仲間をバカにされるのが嫌なだけだからな！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: It's got nothing to do with you personally or anything...
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に
{0}だからとか、
そういう……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Argh, forget this!
You really throw me for a loop sometimes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ
もういい！
ったく、
調子が狂っちまう。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, check it out.
Looks like something's going down over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
向こうで
またなんか騒ぎが起きてるみたいだな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Let's get going!

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Makoto couldn't help but feel a sense of reliability in
{0} as he continued to grow as a beachside officer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海のお巡りさんとして成長する{0}に、
マコトは確かな信頼を感じていた。
